assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional rough geometry, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios are reproducible for this submission but must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Organizer supplies rights-cleared official GIS/CAD polygons.

assumptions.statement: Official FAR, height, road redline, ownership, municipal, fire and heritage controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory intensity, engineering feasibility, demolition or investment conclusion is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Editable land-use, building, road, green, public-space and phasing layers are AI-generated conceptual design geometry.
assumptions.impact: They describe spatial relationships for professional deepening, not surveyed existing conditions or approved construction.

assumptions.statement: Multilingual service needs are derived from the open-call objective of attracting global AI talent, not from a verified demographic survey.
assumptions.impact: Personas and services require co-design and demand validation before implementation.

assumptions.statement: The five named regional interfaces are proposed knowledge, talent, device and public-service exchange relationships; no partnership, data-sharing arrangement or government coordination is confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Regional flows remain a negotiation map until responsible organizations, permissions and data agreements are identified.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Named organizations validate the role, inputs, outputs, boundaries and accountable contact for each interface.

assumptions.statement: The 24-person co-design sample and three-round accessibility protocol are proposed validation targets, not completed research.
assumptions.impact: No service parity, accessibility or public-benefit result may be claimed until consented tests are completed and summarized.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A consented test register and aggregate results are published with version, limitation and withdrawal records.

assumptions.statement: Operational responsibility, cost class, maintenance source, approval gates and baseline service measures are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: P01-P06 are conditional reference projects; targets are not performance claims and must not be used as budgets or commitments.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A responsible operator, maintenance agreement, cost range and baseline measurement plan are confirmed for each project.
